FICTIONAL campus for investment promotion and leadership briefing, not geographic reconstruction. Photoreal architectural maquette at dusk, 40 degree downward elevated oblique camera, entire campus fits frame. Model must be tangible with fine crafted facades, not transparent blue boxes. A1 softly outlined cyan and labeled “A1 科创大厦”. Bottom quiet tabs “园区总览” and “重点楼宇”. Generous negative space, thin separators and immaculate civic exhibition typography.
